summary: This tutorial covers basic formatting and text alignment in LibreOffice Writer, a component of the LibreOffice suite. It starts with opening a new document and demonstrates how to align text to the left, right, or justify it. The tutorial explains how to insert bullets and numbering for lists, customize bullet styles, and adjust indentation levels. It also covers using copy and paste functions to duplicate text within a document. The instructions include keyboard shortcuts for these operations, such as Ctrl+C for copy and Ctrl+V for paste. The session concludes with practical examples of applying these features to create structured and visually appealing documents.
